description: FROZEN CONTRACT — do not edit without conductor approval. Per-million-token provider pricing used to estimate usage.v1.usd. All model entries live under `models`, keyed by OpenRouter model id in `org/model` form: look up prices['models'][model_id]. Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Reasoning tokens bill at the output rate for every model listed here. Formula: usd = in_tokens/1e6 * in_per_m + out_tokens/1e6 * out_per_m, with reasoning tokens already included in out_tokens.
